purpose: Comprehensive default discovery catalog; actual access is discovered and reported, never assumed.
route_note: Other listed routes are potential integrations, not installed adapters. Current Codex supplies live discovery across enabled families. PDFs and inaccessible sources report gaps. The profiles bound structured operations and tool calls; provider-internal reasoning/request counts are unavailable.

channels.name: General web discovery
channels.policy: Attempt early broad discovery, synonyms and disconfirming searches.

channels.name: Original project/provider documentation
channels.policy: Follow canonical documentation and release pages discovered in the run.

channels.name: GitHub repositories and discussions
channels.policy: Use stable repository identity; repository docs/issues are related origins.

channels.name: Other code forges
channels.policy: Discover beyond GitHub; do not treat mirrors as independent endorsement.

channels.name: Package/model/dataset registries
channels.policy: Validate metadata at canonical registries; installs/downloads have known biases.

channels.name: Hacker News discussions
channels.policy: Independent experiences and caveats; comments in one thread are capped.

channels.name: Stack Exchange communities
channels.policy: Choose relevant community; not just software.

channels.name: Reddit community discussions
channels.policy: Indexed leads or authorized access only; no denied-access scraping.

channels.name: Standards and reference institutions
channels.policy: Use ratification/current status evidence; do not buy or bypass restricted standards.

channels.name: Research papers and scholarly metadata
channels.policy: Broaden institutions by subject; preprint/citation counts are not replication.

channels.name: Independent technical/practitioner sources
channels.policy: Discover other appropriate publications dynamically; avoid syndication double count.

channels.name: Videos, newsletters and feeds
channels.policy: Use attributable metadata or permitted source text; no required video downloads.
